pages.title: Physarum Culture
pages.text: A single yellow cell the size of a plate, with millions of nuclei. Set oat flakes out as cities and it links them with the shortest network it can: it once laid out Tokyo's railways. It dies if carried about too long. Made on the Mycelium Bed.
